cervical spondylosis.description: Cervical spondylosis is age-related wear and tear affecting the spinal disks in the neck.
cervical spondylosis.advice: Practice good posture and consult a physician if pain persists.

impetigo.description: Impetigo is a contagious bacterial skin infection common in children.
impetigo.advice: Maintain hygiene and seek medical treatment for antibiotics.

urinary tract infection.description: A urinary tract infection (UTI) is an infection in any part of the urinary system.
urinary tract infection.advice: Drink plenty of fluids and consult a doctor for antibiotics.

arthritis.description: Arthritis is inflammation of one or more joints causing pain and stiffness.
arthritis.advice: Exercise gently and consult a physician for proper management.

dengue.description: Dengue is a mosquito-borne viral infection causing high fever and severe body pain.
dengue.advice: Seek immediate medical care if high fever persists.

common cold.description: The common cold is a viral infection affecting the nose and throat.
common cold.advice: Rest and stay hydrated. Consult a doctor if symptoms worsen.

drug reaction.description: A drug reaction is an adverse response to medication.
drug reaction.advice: Stop medication immediately and consult a healthcare professional.

fungal infection.description: Fungal infections are caused by fungi affecting skin or other body parts.
fungal infection.advice: Use antifungal medication and maintain hygiene.

malaria.description: Malaria is a mosquito-borne infectious disease caused by parasites.
malaria.advice: Seek urgent medical attention for diagnosis and treatment.

allergy.description: Allergy is an immune system reaction to foreign substances.
allergy.advice: Avoid allergens and consult a doctor for antihistamines.

bronchial asthma.description: Bronchial asthma is a chronic condition affecting airways causing breathing difficulty.
bronchial asthma.advice: Use prescribed inhalers and avoid triggers.

varicose veins.description: Varicose veins are swollen twisted veins visible under the skin.
varicose veins.advice: Elevate legs and consult a doctor if pain increases.

migraine.description: Migraine is a neurological disorder causing intense throbbing headaches.
migraine.advice: Rest in a dark room and consult a doctor if frequent.

hypertension.description: Hypertension is a condition where blood pressure is persistently high.
hypertension.advice: Monitor blood pressure regularly and consult a physician.

gastroesophageal reflux disease.description: GERD is a digestive disorder where stomach acid irritates the food pipe.
gastroesophageal reflux disease.advice: Avoid spicy food and consult a doctor if persistent.

pneumonia.description: Pneumonia is an infection that inflames air sacs in one or both lungs.
pneumonia.advice: Seek medical attention for antibiotics and proper care.

psoriasis.description: Psoriasis is a chronic autoimmune skin disease.
psoriasis.advice: Consult a dermatologist for appropriate treatment.

diabetes.description: Diabetes is a metabolic disease causing high blood sugar levels.
diabetes.advice: Maintain healthy diet and consult a doctor regularly.

jaundice.description: Jaundice is yellowing of the skin and eyes due to liver issues.

chicken pox.description: Chicken pox is a contagious viral infection causing itchy rash.
chicken pox.advice: Isolate and consult a doctor if severe.

typhoid.description: Typhoid is a bacterial infection spread through contaminated food and water.

peptic ulcer disease.description: Peptic ulcer disease involves sores in the stomach lining.
peptic ulcer disease.advice: Avoid NSAIDs and consult a doctor for proper treatment.
